component.name: rttx
component.summary: A tiling terminal emulator for GNOME

description.p: rttx is a tiling terminal emulator built with GTK4 and Libadwaita, organized around named workspaces and split panes. The rttx-server daemon owns each workspace's pane tree and durable state, so persistent workspaces, per-pane shell history, and the visible screen survive detach, reconnect, and daemon restart. It also features input synchronization, saved places and reusable command snippets, and drag-and-drop layout rearrangement.

screenshot.caption: rttx with split panes and workspace sidebar

description.p: Adds a Support link in the About window and a donation URL for software centers, ships the reworked Fedora source package, and fixes terminal-mode reset after a daemon restart.
First stable release: server-authoritative workspaces with durable pane identity and crash-safe per-pane shell history, plus a clean 1.0 baseline with all pre-release migration code removed.
This release adds disconnect visualization for persistent panes, remote daemon lifecycle management, and force retry for stuck connections.
